subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: What permanent contract should OpenClaw use for selected model, resolved provider model, and provider-billed cost when `openrouter/auto` routes a turn?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable API/display shape affects session state, transcripts, usage templates, status output, and local-versus-provider cost semantics.

options.title: Define additive metadata contract
options.body: Add resolved-model and provider-billed-cost metadata alongside the selected model, then update all user-facing usage/status surfaces consistently.

options.title: Limit to footer display
options.body: Only append the resolved model and billed cost in reply footers, accepting that runtime/session/status consumers may remain inconsistent.

options.title: Fold into broader observability work
options.body: Designate a broader related issue as canonical and explicitly preserve this OpenRouter auto footer use case in that scope.

recommendation.title: Define additive metadata contract
recommendation.body: Add resolved-model and provider-billed-cost metadata alongside the selected model, then update all user-facing usage/status surfaces consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent OpenRouter cost reconciliation and runtime refactor history makes them the best current owner for the cross-surface contract decision.
